applies_why: Yes: the judge text decides the Isaiah 7:14 link underdetermined because the sign verse itself does not state the mechanism, which is a verse-by-verse stating-verse test rather than chain-against-chain weighing by footing.
quote: the sign itself does not state the mechanism.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: the phrase 'never verse by verse': I weighed whether it forbids deciding this link by whether the sign verse itself states the mechanism, or only forbids counting individual verses without chain footing; I read it as forbidding the former.
why: The judge text treats the absence of mechanism from the single Immanuel sign as decisive, rather than weighing CR2 and DR3 as chains by footing.
